channel.title: Cyber Threat Wall — New KEVs
channel.description: Vulnerabilities newly appearing in CISA's Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog.

item.title: CVE-2026-75650 — Adobe Commerce and Magento
item.description: Threat Signal 69. Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source contain an improper neutralization of special elements used in a template engine vulnerability that could allow an attacker to execute arbitrary code.

item.title: CVE-2026-86218 — N-able N-central
item.description: Threat Signal 69. N-able N-central contains a static code injection vulnerability that could allow for pre-authentication remote code execution.

item.title: CVE-2026-81963 — Microsoft Windows
item.description: Threat Signal 63. Microsoft Windows Update Stack contains a link following vulnerability that allows a local attacker to escalate privileges locally up to SYSTEM.

item.title: CVE-2026-85880 — Microsoft Windows
item.description: Threat Signal 63. Microsoft Windows Advanced Local Procedure Call contains a heap-based buffer overflow vulnerability that allows an attacker to elevate privileges locally.
